```{r setup, message = FALSE, warning = FALSE}
draw_label_theme <- function(label, theme = NULL, element = "text", ...) {
  if (is.null(theme)) {
    theme <- ggplot2::theme_get()
  }
  if (!element %in% names(theme)) {
    stop("Element must be a valid ggplot theme element name")
  }

  elements <- ggplot2::calc_element(element, theme)

  cowplot::draw_label(label, 
                      fontfamily = elements$family,
                      fontface = elements$face,
                      colour = elements$color,
                      size = elements$size,
                      ...
  )
}
```

# import IP families from ALRA-run aparasitemic and parasitemic ex vivo data

```{r import IP data across aparasitemic and parasitemic, include=TRUE}

# aparasitemic 

temp<- tempfile(fileext = ".rds")
dl <- drive_download(
as_id("19xTVjkCrVzVyv4xw26q-pxW-jZniC4w7"), path = temp, overwrite = TRUE)
apara_scores <- readRDS(file = dl$local_path)

# apara_scores <- readRDS("exvivo_apara_82k_filt_interaction_programs.rds") # local

# parasitemic

temp<- tempfile(fileext = ".rds")
dl <- drive_download(
as_id("10yqt75q1URY91OQorarsw0Y_OY1IMhd7"), path = temp, overwrite = TRUE)
para_scores <- readRDS(file = dl$local_path)

# para_scores <- readRDS("exvivo_para_82k_filt_interaction_programs.rds") # local
```

# create tables

```{r create joint table for all IPs, include=TRUE}

apara_scores_df <- apara_scores %>%
  mutate(name = paste0(name, " aparasitemic")) %>%
  subset(name %in% c("IP-5 aparasitemic",
                               "IP-6 aparasitemic",
                               "IP-9 aparasitemic",
                               "IP-10 aparasitemic",
                               "IP-13 aparasitemic",
                               "IP-16 aparasitemic",
                               "IP-19 aparasitemic")) %>%
  dplyr::rename("IP" = "name") %>%
  dplyr::rename("p value" = "Aparasitemic_pval") %>%
  dplyr::rename("connectivity" = "Aparasitemic_connectivity") %>%
  #dplyr::select(lr_pair, IP) %>%
  mutate(class = "aparasitemic")

para_scores_df <- para_scores %>%
  mutate(name = paste0(name, " parasitemic")) %>%
  subset(name %in% c("IP-2 parasitemic",
                               "IP-6 parasitemic",
                               "IP-9 parasitemic",
                               "IP-12 parasitemic")) %>%
  dplyr::rename("IP" = "name") %>%
  dplyr::rename("p value" = "Parasitemic_pval") %>%
  dplyr::rename("connectivity" = "Parasitemic_connectivity") %>%
  #dplyr::select(lr_pair, IP) %>%
  mutate(class = "parasitemic")


ip_scores_all <- rbind(apara_scores_df, 
                       para_scores_df)
```
